searchText: <@!364458974906548225> What is the purpose of the ENR database in your feature list: https://notes.ethereum.org/8LbisMwtR4yK64SBosb_2g#C---ENR-Database ? Is it about storing (useful) ENRs to quickly connect to peers when the node gets started or restarted? And thus also avoid relying solely on bootstrap nodes. Or rather about having some sort of additional "cache" of useful peers aside from the routing table (although I'm not sure of why that would be needed right now). Does your routing table store the full enr? Or just nodeid? Full ENR Kk, then you probably don't need that functionality. Ah, so you meant it as a lookup database of nodeid to ENR mapping? In the python prototypes, routing table was nodeid only. So the database was used to look up endpoint information Right, got it. Yes, to look up ip address and port OK, cool. Thanks for clarifying that. An ENR (persistent) database will still be useful for us to bootstrap from after restart. The trin team is thinking about starting a new channel for trin-specific implementation discussion. We don't want to overload this channel from its more general portal network discussion. There are a couple of options, and I'm curious if anybody else has any thoughts / ideas. 1️⃣ for a `#portal-trin` channel in the Eth R&D discord server or 2️⃣ for a new Portal Network discord server that would host all Portal Network related channels & discussion I'd 👎 option 1️⃣ as there's no other channels here that focus on specific client implementations of things, so maybe this is just a question of whether we want to do 2️⃣ Makes sense - well how about a 👍 for moving to a new discord server or 👎 for keeping the general discussion here (and trin-specific discussion will find a home elsewhere) I'm also looking to rename our specification repository https://github.com/ethereum/stateless-ethereum-specs to `portal-network-specs` and finish clearing out everything from that repository that isn't portal network related.

excerpts.author: deme1744
excerpts.content:
<@!364458974906548225> What is the purpose of the ENR database in your feature list: https://notes.ethereum.org/8LbisMwtR4yK64SBosb_2g#C---ENR-Database ? 
Is it about storing (useful) ENRs to quickly connect to peers when the node gets started or restarted? And thus also avoid relying solely on bootstrap nodes.
Or rather about having some sort of additional "cache" of useful peers aside from the routing table (although I'm not sure of why that would be needed right now).

excerpts.author: pipermerriam
excerpts.content: Does your routing table store the full enr? Or just nodeid?

excerpts.author: pipermerriam
excerpts.content: Kk, then you probably don't need that functionality.

excerpts.author: deme1744
excerpts.content: Ah, so you meant it as a lookup database of nodeid to ENR mapping?

excerpts.author: pipermerriam
excerpts.content: In the python prototypes, routing table was nodeid only. So the database was used to look up endpoint information

excerpts.author: pipermerriam
excerpts.content: Yes, to look up ip address and port

excerpts.author: deme1744
excerpts.content:
OK, cool. Thanks for clarifying that. 
An ENR (persistent) database  will still be useful for us to bootstrap from after restart.

excerpts.author: nick.ghita
excerpts.content: The trin team is thinking about starting a new channel for trin-specific implementation discussion. We don't want to overload this channel from its more general portal network discussion. There are a couple of options, and I'm curious if anybody else has any thoughts / ideas. 1️⃣  for a `#portal-trin` channel in the Eth R&D discord server or 2️⃣ for a new Portal Network discord server that would host all Portal Network related channels & discussion

excerpts.author: pipermerriam
excerpts.content: I'd 👎 option 1️⃣ as there's no other channels here that focus on specific client implementations of things, so maybe this is just a question of whether we want to do 2️⃣

excerpts.author: nick.ghita
excerpts.content: Makes sense - well how about a 👍 for moving to a new discord server or 👎 for keeping the general discussion here (and trin-specific discussion will find a home elsewhere)

excerpts.author: pipermerriam
excerpts.content: I'm also looking to rename our specification repository https://github.com/ethereum/stateless-ethereum-specs to `portal-network-specs` and finish clearing out everything from that repository that isn't portal network related.
